```{r host_stouffer}
    sum(host_xc$q_combined < 0.10 & host_xc$direction_concordant, na.rm=TRUE),
    "\n", sep="")

readr::write_csv(host_xc,
                 file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables", "host_cross_cohort_DA.csv"))

cat("\n==== Cross-cohort host — top 25 by combined p ====\n")
print(as.data.frame(host_xc %>%
        dplyr::slice_head(n = 25) %>%
        dplyr::select(Gene, UniProt, logFC_pitt, p_pitt,
                      logFC_sheba, p_sheba, p_combined, q_combined,
                      direction_concordant)))
```

## §18.5 — Functional enrichment: goSeq (GO:BP) + GSEA (Hallmarks)

```{r host_enrich_goseq, eval=HOST_HAS_ENSDB && HOST_HAS_GOSEQ}
# goSeq with EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86-derived gene-length bias correction.
# Length bias matters because longer proteins are detected with more peptides
# → higher detection rate → higher chance of being "significant".

edb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86::EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86
# Gene lengths (sum of exonic length per gene)
gene_lengths_raw <- ensembldb::lengthOf(edb, of = "gene")
# Map gene_id → gene_name (symbol) so we can look up by GENE
gene_meta <- ensembldb::genes(edb,
              columns = c("gene_id","gene_name","gene_biotype"),
              return.type = "data.frame")
gene_length_by_symbol <- tibble::tibble(
  gene_id = names(gene_lengths_raw),
  length  = as.integer(gene_lengths_raw)
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_meta %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name),
    by = "gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(median_length = stats::median(length, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop")

run_goseq_host <- function(consensus, label, direction = c("up","down"),
                           p_thresh = 0.10, lfc_thresh = 0) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  # Match against HGNC, not the FragPipe-mnemonic Gene. EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86
  # gene_name uses HGNC symbols. The first run silently failed to match
  # ~95% of host proteins because Gene = "S10A6" doesn't match gene_name = "S100A6".
  df <- consensus %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_limma), !is.na(HGNC)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(HGNC, .keep_all = TRUE)

  is_sig <- df$p_limma < p_thresh &
            (if (direction == "up")  df$logFC >  lfc_thresh
             else                    df$logFC < -lfc_thresh)
  if (sum(is_sig) < 5) {
    cat(label, "— ", direction, "regulated host genes < 5 (n=",
        sum(is_sig), "); skipping goseq.\n", sep="")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # bias.data: median length per HGNC symbol in the same order as the gene vector
  ml <- gene_length_by_symbol$median_length[
          match(df$HGNC, gene_length_by_symbol$gene_name)]
  keep <- !is.na(ml)
  if (sum(keep & is_sig) < 5) {
    cat(label, "— too few ", direction,
        " genes with EnsDb length data after HGNC mapping; skipping goseq.\n",
        sep="")
    return(NULL)
  }
  cat(label, "— ", direction, ": ", sum(is_sig), " sig genes, ", sum(keep),
      "/", nrow(df), " mappable to EnsDb length\n", sep="")

  sig_vec <- as.integer(is_sig[keep])
  names(sig_vec) <- df$HGNC[keep]

  pwf <- tryCatch(
    goseq::nullp(DEgenes = sig_vec, genome = "hg38",
                 id = "geneSymbol",
                 bias.data = ml[keep],
                 plot.fit = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      cat(label, "— goseq::nullp error: ", conditionMessage(e), "\n", sep="")
      NULL
    })
  if (is.null(pwf)) return(NULL)

  go_res <- tryCatch(
    goseq::goseq(pwf, "hg38", "geneSymbol", test.cats = "GO:BP"),
    error = function(e) { NULL })
  if (is.null(go_res)) return(NULL)
  go_res$q_BH <- p.adjust(go_res$over_represented_pvalue, method = "BH")
  go_res
}

go_pitt_up    <- run_goseq_host(pitt_host_consensus,  "Pitt ", "up")
go_pitt_down  <- run_goseq_host(pitt_host_consensus,  "Pitt ", "down")
go_sheba_up   <- run_goseq_host(sheba_host_consensus, "Sheba", "up")
go_sheba_down <- run_goseq_host(sheba_host_consensus, "Sheba", "down")

print_go_top <- function(g, label) {
  if (is.null(g) || nrow(g) == 0) {
    cat(label, ": no GO results\n"); return(invisible())
  }
  cat("==== ", label, " — top 10 GO:BP ====\n", sep="")
  print(g %>%
          dplyr::slice_min(over_represented_pvalue, n = 10) %>%
          dplyr::select(category, term, ontology, numDEInCat, numInCat,
                        over_represented_pvalue, q_BH))
}
print_go_top(go_pitt_up,    "Pitt R-up")
print_go_top(go_pitt_down,  "Pitt R-down (= NR-up)")
print_go_top(go_sheba_up,   "Sheba R-up")
print_go_top(go_sheba_down, "Sheba R-down (= NR-up)")
```

```{r host_enrich_gsea, eval=HOST_HAS_MSIGDBR}
# GSEA on MSigDB Hallmarks — direction-aware ranks.
hallmarks <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
# Newer msigdbr column is gene_symbol; older was human_gene_symbol — be defensive.
sym_col <- if ("gene_symbol" %in% colnames(hallmarks)) {
  "gene_symbol"
} else if ("human_gene_symbol" %in% colnames(hallmarks)) {
  "human_gene_symbol"
} else {
  stop("msigdbr returned an unexpected schema (no gene_symbol col)")
}
 hallmark_t2g <- hallmarks %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, !!rlang::sym(sym_col)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_symbol := !!rlang::sym(sym_col)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

run_gsea_host <- function(consensus, label) {
  # Match against HGNC, not the FragPipe-mnemonic Gene. msigdbr Hallmarks use
  # HGNC symbols. The first run only ranked the small subset of FragPipe
  # mnemonics that happen to coincide with HGNC (e.g., MYH2, ACTN3, TPM3),
  # which is why the Sheba MYOGENESIS hit still came through but most
  # other Hallmarks had setSize=1-2 and no inferential power.
  df <- consensus %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_limma), !is.na(logFC), !is.na(HGNC)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(HGNC, .keep_all = TRUE)
  rk <- sign(df$logFC) * (-log10(pmax(df$p_limma, 1e-300)))
  names(rk) <- df$HGNC
  rk <- sort(rk, decreasing = TRUE)
  cat(label, "— GSEA input: ", length(rk), " HGNC-mapped genes\n", sep="")
  res <- tryCatch(
    clusterProfiler::GSEA(geneList     = rk,
                          minGSSize    = 5,
                          maxGSSize    = 500,
                          pvalueCutoff = 1,
                          eps          = 0,
                          seed         = TRUE,
                          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                          TERM2GENE    = hallmark_t2g %>%
                                          dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)),
    error = function(e) {
      cat(label, "— GSEA error: ", conditionMessage(e), "\n", sep="")
      NULL
    })
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  out <- as.data.frame(res)
  cat(label, "— GSEA Hallmarks: ",
      sum(out$p.adjust < 0.10, na.rm=TRUE), " at q<0.10\n", sep="")
  out
}

gsea_pitt  <- run_gsea_host(pitt_host_consensus,  "Pitt ")
gsea_sheba <- run_gsea_host(sheba_host_consensus, "Sheba")

if (!is.null(gsea_pitt)) {
  cat("==== Pitt Hallmark GSEA — top 10 ====\n")
  print(gsea_pitt %>%
          dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
          head(10) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, NES, pvalue, p.adjust, setSize))
}
if (!is.null(gsea_sheba)) {
  cat("\n==== Sheba Hallmark GSEA — top 10 ====\n")
  print(gsea_sheba %>%
          dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
          head(10) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, NES, pvalue, p.adjust, setSize))
}

# Concordance: hallmarks moving the same direction in both cohorts at p<0.10
gsea_concord <- if (!is.null(gsea_pitt) && !is.null(gsea_sheba)) {
  dplyr::inner_join(
    gsea_pitt  %>% dplyr::transmute(ID, NES_pitt = NES,  p_pitt = pvalue),
    gsea_sheba %>% dplyr::transmute(ID, NES_sheba = NES, p_sheba = pvalue),
    by = "ID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    concordant = sign(NES_pitt) == sign(NES_sheba),
    both_p10   = p_pitt < 0.10 & p_sheba < 0.10
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_pitt + p_sheba)
} else NULL
if (!is.null(gsea_concord)) {
  cat("\n==== Hallmark concordance ====\n")
  cat("  concordant + both p<0.10 : ",
      sum(gsea_concord$concordant & gsea_concord$both_p10), "\n", sep="")
  print(as.data.frame(gsea_concord %>%
          dplyr::filter(concordant, both_p10) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, NES_pitt, p_pitt, NES_sheba, p_sheba)))
}
```

## §18.6 — Targeted lookups: stool host marker panel

```{r host_targeted}
# Stool host proteomics is dominated by a handful of recognizable panels.
# Pre-define them and report R-vs-NR in both cohorts. NOT pre-registered;
# pure descriptive scan.
#
# Iteration 2 expansions (after first run flagged S100A6 as Sheba's #1 R-up
# but the original Calprotectin_S100 panel only listed S100A8/A9/A12):
#   - Calprotectin_S100   → expanded to ALL detected S100* genes via a
#                            data-driven family scan (regex: ^S100[A-Z][0-9]+$)
#   - Muscle_structural   → new panel motivated by Sheba HALLMARK_MYOGENESIS
#                            q=0.02 NR-up (NES=-1.88) and the per-cohort
#                            top hits MYH2/MYH3/ACTN3/TPM3/KCRB
#   - Mitochondrial       → new panel — VDAC3 R-up, CYB R-up, KCRB NR-up
#                            looked like a coherent leakage cluster
#   - Defensins_Paneth    → expanded with REG3A/B/G family + LYZ + DEFB1/4A
#   - Pancreatic          → added LIPF + chymotrypsinogens already there
#
# Note on the family-scan approach: for any panel where we want "all detected
# members of family X", we don't hardcode the list — we glob detected genes
# matching a regex against host_id_{pitt,sheba}, so detection is data-driven.

# Curated panels (updated)
stool_panels_curated <- list(
  Neutrophil          = c("MPO","ELANE","CTSG","BPI","LCN2","LTF","DEFA1","DEFA3",
                          "DEFA4","CAMP","AZU1","PRTN3","CHIT1","CHI3L1","S100A8",
                          "S100A9","S100A12"),
  Defensins_Paneth    = c("DEFA5","DEFA6","DEFB1","DEFB4A","DEFB103A","DEFB103B",
                          "REG3A","REG3G","REG3B","LYZ","CAMP","ITLN1","SLPI"),
  Mucins              = c("MUC2","MUC1","MUC13","MUC3A","MUC4","MUC5AC","MUC5B",
                          "MUC6","FCGBP","CLCA1","TFF3","TFF1","TFF2","ZG16",
                          "AGR2","GALNT","ANO1"),
  Immunoglobulins     = c("IGHA1","IGHA2","IGHG1","IGHG2","IGHG3","IGHG4",
                          "IGHM","IGJ","JCHAIN","IGKC","IGLC1","IGLC2","IGLC3",
                          "IGLC7","PIGR","JAG1"),
  Pancreatic          = c("PNLIP","CELA1","CELA2A","CELA2B","CELA3A","CELA3B",
                          "CTRB1","CTRB2","CTRC","PRSS1","PRSS2","PRSS3","CPA1",
                          "CPA2","CPB1","AMY2A","AMY2B","CLPS","REG1A","REG1B",
                          "PNLIPRP1","PNLIPRP2","SYCN","LIPF","GP2"),
  Brush_border        = c("SI","MGAM","LCT","ANPEP","DPP4","ALPI","FABP1","FABP2",
                          "APOA1","APOA4","APOB","VIL1","SLC5A1","SLC2A5","ENPEP",
                          "MEP1A","MEP1B","TREH"),
  Albumin_serum       = c("ALB","TF","HP","ORM1","A1BG","A2M","SERPINA1","HPX",
                          "APOA1","APOA2","APOH"),
  # NEW post-iteration-1
  Muscle_structural   = c("MYH1","MYH2","MYH3","MYH4","MYH7","MYH8","MYH9","MYL1",
                          "MYL2","MYL3","MYL6B","MYBPC1","MYBPC2","MYBPC3",
                          "ACTA1","ACTA2","ACTN1","ACTN2","ACTN3","ACTN4",
                          "TPM1","TPM2","TPM3","TPM4","TNNC1","TNNC2","TNNI1",
                          "TNNI2","TNNT1","TNNT3","TTN","DES","FLNA","FLNB",
                          "FLNC","NEB","DMD","DAG1","SGCA","SGCB","SGCD","SGCG",
                          "VIM","KRT8","KRT18"),
  Mitochondrial       = c("VDAC1","VDAC2","VDAC3","ATP5A1","ATP5B","ATP5C1",
                          "ATP5F1A","ATP5F1B","ATP5F1C","ATP5MC1","ATP5MC2",
                          "ATP5MG","CYB","COX4I1","COX5A","COX5B","COX6A1",
                          "COX7A2","COX8A","NDUFA1","NDUFA2","NDUFA4","NDUFB1",
                          "NDUFS1","NDUFS2","NDUFS3","SDHA","SDHB","UQCRC1",
                          "UQCRC2","UQCRH","CKB","CKM","CKMT1A","CKMT1B",
                          "CKMT2","SLC25A4","SLC25A5","SLC25A6","TUFM","HADHA"),
  Energy_metabolism   = c("ENO1","ENO2","ENO3","GAPDH","LDHA","LDHB","LDHC",
                          "PKM","TPI1","ALDOA","ALDOB","ALDOC","HK1","HK2",
                          "PFKL","PFKM","PFKP","PGK1","PGAM1","PGAM2","PYGM",
                          "PYGL","GBE1","AGL")
)

# Data-driven family scans — detect all members present in either cohort.
# IMPORTANT: scan against HGNC, not Gene. host_id_* now carries HGNC from
# §18.0 (org.Hs.eg.db UNIPROT→SYMBOL lookup). The FragPipe-stem `Gene` field
# uses UniProt mnemonic stems (S10A6, K1C19, CATD) which don't match the
# canonical HGNC regexes that biology vocabulary uses (S100*, KRT*, CTS*).
all_host_hgnc <- unique(c(host_id_pitt$HGNC, host_id_sheba$HGNC))
all_host_hgnc <- all_host_hgnc[!is.na(all_host_hgnc)]
family_regex_panels <- list(
  S100_family         = "^S100[A-Z][0-9]+$|^S100[BGPZ]$",  # S100A1..A16, S100B/G/P/Z
  Annexins            = "^ANXA[0-9]+$",
  Heat_shock          = "^(HSP|HSPA|HSPB|HSPD|HSPH|HSPE|DNAJ).*",
  Keratins            = "^KRT[0-9]+$|^KRT[0-9]+[A-Z]$",
  Cathepsins          = "^CTS[A-Z]$",
  Serpins             = "^SERPIN[A-Z][0-9]*$",
  Calgranulins        = "^S100A(8|9|12)$",  # canonical calprotectin trio + S100A12
  Defensins           = "^DEF[AB][0-9]+[A-Z]?$",
  Trefoils            = "^TFF[0-9]+$",
  Regenerating        = "^REG[0-9][A-Z]+$"
)
family_scan_panels <- lapply(family_regex_panels, function(rx) {
  hits <- grep(rx, all_host_hgnc, value = TRUE)
  hits[!is.na(hits)]
})
cat("\nData-driven family scans against HGNC (detected members):\n")
for (n in names(family_scan_panels))
  cat("  ", n, " (regex ", family_regex_panels[[n]], "): ",
      length(family_scan_panels[[n]]), " genes -> ",
      paste(head(family_scan_panels[[n]], 12), collapse=", "),
      if (length(family_scan_panels[[n]]) > 12) " ..." else "",
      "\n", sep="")

# Combine curated + family panels into a single dispatch table
stool_panels <- c(stool_panels_curated, family_scan_panels)

# Build long marker table per cohort. Match panels to consensus by HGNC.
# Carry both HGNC (for matching/display) and Gene (FragPipe stem) + UniProt
# (canonical accession) for cross-reference back to the FragPipe headers.
panel_to_long <- function(consensus, cohort_label) {
  panels_df <- tibble::tibble(
    Panel = rep(names(stool_panels), lengths(stool_panels)),
    HGNC  = unlist(stool_panels)
  )
  panels_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      consensus %>% dplyr::distinct(HGNC, Gene, UniProt, logFC, p_limma, q_limma,
                                     diff_RvsNR, p_perm, q_perm),
      by = "HGNC") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort   = cohort_label,
                  detected = !is.na(p_limma))
}
panel_pitt  <- panel_to_long(pitt_host_consensus,  "Pitt")
panel_sheba <- panel_to_long(sheba_host_consensus, "Sheba")
panel_long  <- dplyr::bind_rows(panel_pitt, panel_sheba)

readr::write_csv(panel_long,
                 file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables", "host_marker_panel.csv"))

# Detection summary per panel × cohort
det_summary <- panel_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Panel, Cohort) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_in_panel = dplyr::n(),
                   n_detected = sum(detected),
                   n_p10      = sum(p_limma < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_p10_R_up = sum(p_limma < 0.10 & logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_p10_NR_up= sum(p_limma < 0.10 & logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups    = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from  = Cohort,
                     values_from = c(n_detected, n_p10, n_p10_R_up, n_p10_NR_up),
                     values_fill = 0L)
cat("\n==== Stool host marker panel — detection + nominal hits + direction ====\n")
print(as.data.frame(det_summary))

# Highlight panels with concordant directions (cross-cohort same-direction).
# Match Pitt<->Sheba on UniProt (canonical accession), not HGNC, in case the
# same gene resolves to different HGNC symbols across the two cohorts due to
# alias selection in `slice(1)`. Carry HGNC + Gene for display.
panel_concord <- panel_pitt %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(UniProt)) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(Panel, HGNC, Gene, UniProt,
                   logFC_pitt = logFC, p_pitt = p_limma, q_pitt = q_limma) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    panel_sheba %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(UniProt)) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(UniProt,
                       logFC_sheba = logFC, p_sheba = p_limma, q_sheba = q_limma),
    by = "UniProt", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(logFC_pitt), !is.na(logFC_sheba)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(concordant = sign(logFC_pitt) == sign(logFC_sheba)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Panel, UniProt, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(pmax(p_pitt, p_sheba))

cat("\n==== Marker panel cross-cohort (proteins detected in both) ====\n")
cat("  Total markers detected in both cohorts: ", nrow(panel_concord), "\n",
    "  Concordant direction                  : ",
    sum(panel_concord$concordant), "\n",
    "  Concordant + min(p_pitt,p_sheba)<0.10 : ",
    sum(panel_concord$concordant &
        pmin(panel_concord$p_pitt, panel_concord$p_sheba) < 0.10), "\n",
    "  Concordant + both p<0.10              : ",
    sum(panel_concord$concordant & panel_concord$p_pitt < 0.10 &
        panel_concord$p_sheba < 0.10), "\n", sep="")
print(as.data.frame(panel_concord %>%
        dplyr::filter(concordant,
                      p_pitt < 0.10 | p_sheba < 0.10) %>%
        dplyr::slice_head(n = 40) %>%
        dplyr::select(Panel, HGNC, Gene, UniProt, logFC_pitt, p_pitt,
                      logFC_sheba, p_sheba)))

# Single-cohort hits per panel — for each panel, list members hitting p<0.10
# in either cohort (regardless of cross-cohort detection). This catches things
# like S100A6 that are NA in one cohort but striking in the other.
single_cohort_hits <- panel_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(detected, p_limma < 0.10) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Panel, p_limma) %>%
  dplyr::select(Panel, Cohort, HGNC, Gene, UniProt, logFC, p_limma, q_limma)
cat("\n==== Per-panel single-cohort hits (p_limma<0.10, both cohorts) ====\n")
print(as.data.frame(single_cohort_hits))
readr::write_csv(single_cohort_hits,
                 file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables", "host_panel_single_cohort_hits.csv"))

# Panel-level burden test — Fisher's exact: among detected members of each
# panel, are there more nominal hits than expected by chance (vs the full
# detected host universe)? Done per cohort. Quick & rough.
# Match against HGNC (consistent with panel definitions).
panel_burden_test <- function(consensus, cohort_label) {
  detected_universe <- consensus %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_limma), !is.na(HGNC)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(HGNC, .keep_all = TRUE)
  total_detected <- nrow(detected_universe)
  total_p10      <- sum(detected_universe$p_limma < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)

  out <- lapply(names(stool_panels), function(panel) {
    members <- stool_panels[[panel]]
    in_panel <- detected_universe %>% dplyr::filter(HGNC %in% members)
    n_in_p_det <- nrow(in_panel)
    n_in_p_sig <- sum(in_panel$p_limma < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_out_p_det <- total_detected - n_in_p_det
    n_out_p_sig <- total_p10        - n_in_p_sig
    if (n_in_p_det < 3) return(NULL)   # skip tiny panels
    ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(n_in_p_sig,        n_in_p_det - n_in_p_sig,
                               n_out_p_sig,       n_out_p_det - n_out_p_sig),
                             nrow = 2, byrow = FALSE),
                      alternative = "greater")
    tibble::tibble(Panel = panel, Cohort = cohort_label,
                   n_in_panel_detected = n_in_p_det,
                   n_in_panel_p10      = n_in_p_sig,
                   p_burden            = ft$p.value,
                   OR_burden           = unname(ft$estimate))
  })
  dplyr::bind_rows(out) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(q_burden = p.adjust(p_burden, method = "BH")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p_burden)
}
panel_burden <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  panel_burden_test(pitt_host_consensus,  "Pitt"),
  panel_burden_test(sheba_host_consensus, "Sheba")
)
cat("\n==== Panel burden test (Fisher's exact, one-sided enrichment) ====\n")
print(as.data.frame(panel_burden))
readr::write_csv(panel_burden,
                 file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables", "host_panel_burden.csv"))
```

## §18.7 — Cross-omic: host vs microbial features (mg_state)

```{r host_cross_omic, eval=!is.null(mg_state)}
# Per overlap subset (n=70 Pitt + 32 Sheba): for each top host hit (q<0.10
# combined OR p<0.05 in either cohort), correlate against:
#   (a) mg_state$verif_genus hits (the 3 pre-spec genera)
#   (b) any pathway the caller names (none by default: the pathway
#       verification tables went with the descoped hypothesis layer)
#
# This tests: does the host-protein signal lie on the same axis as known
# microbial findings, or is it orthogonal? Important context for the
# Outcome A/B/C framing in the handoff.

# Top host targets to cross-correlate. Two sources:
#  (a) Cross-cohort §18.4 hits: concordant + p_combined<0.10 (relaxed from
#      <0.05 because §18.3 found nothing at q<0.10 — at p_combined<0.05
#      we get ~6 proteins, which is too few to also subset against an
#      enrichment story).
#  (b) "Iteration 2 add-ons": the Sheba HALLMARK_MYOGENESIS q=0.02 NR-up
#      finding implicates the muscle/structural cluster (MYH2, MYH3, ACTN3,
#      TPM3, KCRB, FLNC). These are added explicitly even if they don't meet
#      cross-cohort criteria — we want to know if they correlate with
#      microbiome features INDEPENDENT of cohort.
#  (c) S100A6: Sheba's #1 R-up; not detected in Pitt (so no cross-cohort p).
#      Added so it appears in the per-cohort Spearman table.
#  All targets identified by UniProt accession.

host_targets_xc <- host_xc %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction_concordant,
                p_combined < 0.10) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_combined) %>%
  dplyr::pull(UniProt)

# Curated muscle/mito/inflammation add-ons. Match against both HGNC and
# the FragPipe-mnemonic Gene to catch either naming convention. Original
# list mixed both: S100A6/MYH2 are HGNC, KCRB/AMPN/PERM are FragPipe stems.
curated_genes <- c(
  # HGNC names
  "MYH2","MYH3","ACTN3","TPM3","FLNC","CKB","VDAC3",
  "S100A6","S100A8","S100A9","S100A12","ELANE","PRTN3","MPO","DPP4",
  "MYBPC1","MYBPC2","TNNT3","TTN","DES",
  # FragPipe stems for the same/related proteins (caught defensively in case
  # HGNC mapping failed for some)
  "KCRB","AMPN","NGAL","PERM","CATG","ANTR","CYB","S10A6","S10A8","S10A9","S10AC"
)
curated_targets <- dplyr::bind_rows(host_id_pitt, host_id_sheba) %>%
  dplyr::filter(HGNC %in% curated_genes | Gene %in% curated_genes) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(UniProt) %>%
  dplyr::pull(UniProt)

host_targets <- unique(c(host_targets_xc, curated_targets))
cat("§18.7 host targets: ", length(host_targets_xc), " from cross-cohort + ",
    length(setdiff(curated_targets, host_targets_xc)),
    " curated add-ons = ", length(host_targets), " total UniProt accessions\n",
    sep="")

# Build per-sample host abundance matrix on the cross-omic overlap subset.
# Sample IDs in combined_meta use Cohort_Mixture_Channel format; the host
# matrices use Mixture_Channel. Harmonize.
host_long_combined <- function(mat, cohort_label) {
  mat_renamed <- mat
  colnames(mat_renamed) <- paste(cohort_label, colnames(mat), sep = "_")
  as.data.frame(mat_renamed) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Protein") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Protein, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "logAbund") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(logAbund)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort = cohort_label)
}
pitt_host_long  <- host_long_combined(pitt_host_mat_f,  "Pitt")
sheba_host_long <- host_long_combined(sheba_host_mat_f, "Sheba")
host_long_xc <- dplyr::bind_rows(pitt_host_long, sheba_host_long) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::bind_rows(host_id_pitt, host_id_sheba) %>% dplyr::distinct(),
    by = c("Protein" = "ProteinName"))

# Restrict to targets and cross-omic-overlap samples
xc_samples <- combined_meta$Sample[combined_meta$mg_overlap]
host_xc_long <- host_long_xc %>%
  dplyr::filter(UniProt %in% host_targets,
                Sample  %in% xc_samples)
cat("Cross-omic host-target long table: ", nrow(host_xc_long),
    " observations across ", length(unique(host_xc_long$Sample)),
    " overlap samples\n", sep="")

# Pull microbial features from mg_state for the overlap subset.
# Sample-ID bridge: combined_meta uses metaproteomics-style "Cohort_Mix_Chan";
# mg_state uses metagenomics-style "p87" / "MF0030pGTSH...". Bridge via
# BioReplicate which we joined in §1.3.
md_mp_to_mg <- combined_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(mg_overlap) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, BioReplicate, Cohort)

# Path abundances: mg_state$path_combo is path × sample (385 × 103).
# Genus abundances: mg_state$combo_genus is a microtable; pull $otu_table.
get_mg_feature_long <- function(mg_state, pwy_to_pull = character(0)) {
  # Pathways to cross-correlate, named by the caller. The pathway verification
  # tables this used to read were the descoped hypothesis layer and are gone;
  # with none named, the genus branch below carries the analysis on its own.
  pwy_to_pull <- intersect(pwy_to_pull, rownames(mg_state$path_combo))

  pwy_long <- if (length(pwy_to_pull) > 0) {
    as.data.frame(mg_state$path_combo[pwy_to_pull, , drop = FALSE]) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-Feature, names_to = "mg_Sample",
                           values_to = "value") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(FeatureType = "Pathway")
  } else NULL

  # Genera: pre-spec verif_genus + Phocaeicola
  genus_long <- NULL
  if (!is.null(mg_state$combo_genus)) {
    otu  <- as.data.frame(mg_state$combo_genus$otu_table)
    taxa <- as.data.frame(mg_state$combo_genus$tax_table)
    genus_targets <- character(0)
    if (!is.null(mg_state$verif_genus)) {
      if ("Genus"   %in% colnames(mg_state$verif_genus))
        genus_targets <- c(genus_targets, mg_state$verif_genus$Genus)
      if ("feature" %in% colnames(mg_state$verif_genus))
        genus_targets <- c(genus_targets, mg_state$verif_genus$feature)
    }
    genus_targets <- unique(c(genus_targets, "Phocaeicola"))
    # Match by Genus column in tax_table
    genus_col_candidates <- intersect(c("Genus","g","g__"), colnames(taxa))
    if (length(genus_col_candidates) >= 1) {
      gcol <- genus_col_candidates[1]
      keep_rows <- taxa[[gcol]] %in% genus_targets |
                   sub("^[a-z]__","", taxa[[gcol]]) %in% genus_targets
      if (any(keep_rows)) {
        otu_keep <- otu[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
        rownames(otu_keep) <- taxa[[gcol]][keep_rows]
        genus_long <- as.data.frame(otu_keep) %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
          tidyr::pivot_longer(-Feature, names_to = "mg_Sample",
                               values_to = "value") %>%
          dplyr::mutate(FeatureType = "Genus")
      }
    }
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(pwy_long, genus_long)
}

mg_long <- tryCatch(get_mg_feature_long(mg_state),
                    error = function(e) {
                      cat("§18.7 — mg_state extraction failed: ",
                          conditionMessage(e), "; skipping cross-omic.\n",
                          sep="")
                      NULL
                    })

if (!is.null(mg_long) && nrow(mg_long) > 0 && nrow(host_xc_long) > 0) {
  # Bridge mg_Sample to metaproteomics Sample via BioReplicate.
  # mg_state$md_combo has SampleID as the mg sample key; metadata_join in §1.3
  # extracted BioReplicate from it. So we re-use that mapping.
  mg_to_bio <- mg_state$md_combo %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      mg_Sample = SampleID,
      Cohort,
      BioReplicate = dplyr::case_when(
        Cohort == "Pitt"  ~ stringr::str_extract(SampleID, "^MF\\d+"),
        Cohort == "Sheba" ~ stringr::str_replace(SampleID,
                                                  "^p(\\d+[AB]?).*", "\\1")
      ))
  # Join: mg_long → BioReplicate → metaproteomics Sample
  bridge <- md_mp_to_mg %>%
    dplyr::left_join(mg_to_bio, by = c("BioReplicate","Cohort"))

  combined_xc <- host_xc_long %>%
    dplyr::transmute(Sample, host_Gene = Gene, host_UniProt = UniProt,
                     host_logAbund = logAbund) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(bridge, by = "Sample") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(mg_long, by = "mg_Sample",
                     relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(host_logAbund))

  if (nrow(combined_xc) > 0) {
    # ---- §18.7a — POOLED Spearman (kept only as a footnote/diagnostic) ----
    # The first run produced 35/72 pairs at q<0.10 — implausibly high. The
    # cause is cohort confounding: most of our host targets (post-§18.4 filter)
    # are detected predominantly in one cohort, and the metagenomic features
    # come from `verif_genus` (response-axis-selected). When
    # both axes covary with Cohort, a pooled rho picks up the cohort effect.
    # We compute it but flag it as not-the-inferential-test.
    host_mg_corr_pooled <- combined_xc %>%
      dplyr::group_by(host_UniProt, host_Gene, FeatureType, Feature) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n        = dplyr::n(),
        rho      = if (n() >= 10)
                     suppressWarnings(stats::cor(host_logAbund, value,
                                                 method = "spearman",
                                                 use = "complete.obs"))
                   else NA_real_,
        p_spear  = if (n() >= 10)
                     suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(host_logAbund, value,
                                          method = "spearman",
                                          exact = FALSE)$p.value)
                   else NA_real_,
        .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(q_spear = p.adjust(p_spear, method = "BH")) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(p_spear)

    # ---- §18.7b — WITHIN-COHORT Spearman, then meta-combine via Stouffer's --
    # Per host_target × mg_feature × cohort: compute Spearman within Pitt
    # (n≤70) and within Sheba (n≤32), then combine the two p-values with
    # equal sample-size weighting (rho is direction; weights = sqrt(n)).
    # If a target has data in only one cohort, report cohort-specific result
    # only. This is the inferential test.
    safe_spearman <- function(x, y) {
      keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
      if (sum(keep) < 10) return(c(rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = sum(keep)))
      tt <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(x[keep], y[keep],
                                              method = "spearman",
                                              exact = FALSE))
      c(rho = unname(tt$estimate), p = tt$p.value, n = sum(keep))
    }

    per_cohort_corr <- combined_xc %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Cohort, host_UniProt, host_Gene, FeatureType, Feature) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        out = list(safe_spearman(host_logAbund, value)),
        .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(rho = sapply(out, "[[", "rho"),
                    p   = sapply(out, "[[", "p"),
                    n   = sapply(out, "[[", "n")) %>%
      dplyr::select(-out)

    # Meta-combine: Stouffer's z, sample-size-weighted, sign-aware
    rho_to_signed_z <- function(rho, p) {
      # Convert one-sided p (in direction of rho) to z
      p_one <- ifelse(is.na(rho) | is.na(p), NA_real_,
                      ifelse(rho >= 0, p / 2, 1 - p / 2))
      qnorm(1 - p_one)
    }
    host_mg_corr_meta <- per_cohort_corr %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from  = Cohort,
        values_from = c(rho, p, n),
        values_fill = list(rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = 0L)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        z_pitt   = rho_to_signed_z(rho_Pitt,  p_Pitt),
        z_sheba  = rho_to_signed_z(rho_Sheba, p_Sheba),
        w_pitt   = sqrt(n_Pitt),
        w_sheba  = sqrt(n_Sheba),
        # Stouffer (only over cohorts where the test ran)
        z_combined = ifelse(
          !is.na(z_pitt) & !is.na(z_sheba),
          (w_pitt * z_pitt + w_sheba * z_sheba) /
            sqrt(w_pitt^2 + w_sheba^2),
          ifelse(!is.na(z_pitt),  z_pitt,
          ifelse(!is.na(z_sheba), z_sheba, NA_real_))),
        p_combined = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_combined)),
        direction_concordant = sign(rho_Pitt) == sign(rho_Sheba),
        n_total = n_Pitt + n_Sheba
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(q_combined = p.adjust(p_combined, method = "BH")) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(p_combined)

    # ---- §18.7c — PARTIAL Spearman residualizing on Cohort (and Mixture) ----
    # Independent sanity check: regress logAbund and value on Cohort (and
    # Mixture as a within-cohort batch covariate where available) using rank
    # transforms, then correlate residuals. This is the rank-based partial
    # correlation. If §18.7b is right, §18.7c should agree directionally.
    pcor_cohort_mix <- function(df) {
      if (nrow(df) < 12) return(c(rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = nrow(df)))
      d <- df
      d$rank_host <- rank(d$host_logAbund)
      d$rank_mg   <- rank(d$value)
      # Use Mixture if at least 2 levels; otherwise just Cohort
      if (length(unique(d$Mixture)) > 1 && length(unique(d$Cohort)) > 1) {
        rh <- residuals(lm(rank_host ~ Cohort + factor(Mixture), data = d))
        rm <- residuals(lm(rank_mg   ~ Cohort + factor(Mixture), data = d))
      } else if (length(unique(d$Cohort)) > 1) {
        rh <- residuals(lm(rank_host ~ Cohort, data = d))
        rm <- residuals(lm(rank_mg   ~ Cohort, data = d))
      } else if (length(unique(d$Mixture)) > 1) {
        rh <- residuals(lm(rank_host ~ factor(Mixture), data = d))
        rm <- residuals(lm(rank_mg   ~ factor(Mixture), data = d))
      } else {
        rh <- d$rank_host; rm <- d$rank_mg
      }
      tt <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(rh, rm,
                                              method = "pearson",  # already ranks
                                              exact = FALSE))
      c(rho = unname(tt$estimate), p = tt$p.value, n = nrow(d))
    }

    # Need Mixture in combined_xc to do the partial — pull it from combined_meta
    combined_xc_with_mix <- combined_xc %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        combined_meta %>% dplyr::distinct(Sample, Mixture),
        by = "Sample")

    host_mg_corr_partial <- combined_xc_with_mix %>%
      dplyr::group_by(host_UniProt, host_Gene, FeatureType, Feature) %>%
      dplyr::group_modify(~ {
        out <- pcor_cohort_mix(.x)
        tibble::tibble(rho_partial = out["rho"],
                       p_partial   = out["p"],
                       n_partial   = out["n"])
      }) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(q_partial = p.adjust(p_partial, method = "BH")) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(p_partial)

    # ---- §18.7d — Combine all three views into one table -------------------
    host_mg_corr <- host_mg_corr_meta %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        host_mg_corr_pooled %>%
          dplyr::transmute(host_UniProt, host_Gene, FeatureType, Feature,
                           rho_pooled = rho, p_pooled = p_spear, n_pooled = n),
        by = c("host_UniProt","host_Gene","FeatureType","Feature")) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        host_mg_corr_partial %>%
          dplyr::transmute(host_UniProt, host_Gene, FeatureType, Feature,
                           rho_partial, p_partial, q_partial, n_partial),
        by = c("host_UniProt","host_Gene","FeatureType","Feature"))

    readr::write_csv(host_mg_corr,
                     file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables", "host_microbial_correlations.csv"))

    cat("\n==== Host-microbial cross-omic correlations ====\n")
    cat("Total pairs tested        : ", nrow(host_mg_corr), "\n", sep="")
    cat("\nPOOLED Spearman (NOT inferential — cohort confounding):\n")
    cat("  p_pooled<0.05         : ",
        sum(host_mg_corr$p_pooled < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), "\n", sep="")
    cat("\nWITHIN-COHORT meta (Stouffer's, per-cohort then combined) — INFERENTIAL:\n")
    cat("  p_combined<0.05       : ",
        sum(host_mg_corr$p_combined < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), "\n",
        "  q_combined<0.10       : ",
        sum(host_mg_corr$q_combined < 0.10, na.rm=TRUE), "\n",
        "  q<0.10 + concordant   : ",
        sum(host_mg_corr$q_combined < 0.10 &
            host_mg_corr$direction_concordant, na.rm=TRUE),
        "\n", sep="")
    cat("\nPARTIAL Spearman (residualizing on Cohort + Mixture) — sanity check:\n")
    cat("  p_partial<0.05        : ",
        sum(host_mg_corr$p_partial < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), "\n",
        "  q_partial<0.10        : ",
        sum(host_mg_corr$q_partial < 0.10, na.rm=TRUE), "\n", sep="")

    cat("\n==== Top 20 by within-cohort meta-combined p ====\n")
    print(as.data.frame(host_mg_corr %>%
            dplyr::slice_head(n = 20) %>%
            dplyr::select(host_Gene, FeatureType, Feature,
                          rho_Pitt,  p_Pitt,
                          rho_Sheba, p_Sheba,
                          p_combined, q_combined,
                          rho_partial, p_partial,
                          rho_pooled,  p_pooled)))

    cat("\n==== Top 10 partial-Spearman hits (Cohort+Mixture-residualized) ====\n")
    print(as.data.frame(host_mg_corr %>%
            dplyr::arrange(p_partial) %>%
            dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) %>%
            dplyr::select(host_Gene, FeatureType, Feature,
                          rho_partial, p_partial, q_partial,
                          rho_pooled, p_pooled)))

    # Diagnostic: how often does pooled disagree with partial?
    disagree <- host_mg_corr %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(rho_pooled), !is.na(rho_partial),
                    p_pooled < 0.05) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(pooled_lost_after_partial = p_partial > 0.10) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_pooled_p05  = dplyr::n(),
        n_lost_partial = sum(pooled_lost_after_partial, na.rm=TRUE)
      )
    cat("\n==== Confounding diagnostic ====\n")
    cat("  pairs at p_pooled<0.05         : ", disagree$n_pooled_p05, "\n",
        "  ...that vanish at p_partial>0.10: ", disagree$n_lost_partial,
        " (",
        round(100*disagree$n_lost_partial/max(1,disagree$n_pooled_p05), 1),
        "% — high pct suggests cohort confounding drove pooled signal)\n",
        sep="")
  } else {
    cat("§18.7 — no overlapping samples between host targets and mg_state; ",
        "skipping correlation.\n", sep="")
    host_mg_corr <- NULL
  }
} else {
  cat("§18.7 — no host targets or no mg_state features; skipping correlation.\n")
}
```

## §18.8 — Save host analysis state

```{r host_save}
# Save host outputs to the §20 saveRDS list — append rather than overwrite.
# (The actual saveRDS call lives in §20; here we just bundle host objects
#  into a list so §20 can reference them via `if (exists("host_state"))`.)
host_state <- list(
  pitt_host_mat_f       = pitt_host_mat_f,
  sheba_host_mat_f      = sheba_host_mat_f,
  pitt_host_consensus   = pitt_host_consensus,
  sheba_host_consensus  = sheba_host_consensus,
  host_xc               = host_xc,
  permanova_host_pitt   = permanova_host_pitt,
  permanova_host_sheba  = permanova_host_sheba,
  go_pitt_up            = if (exists("go_pitt_up"))    go_pitt_up    else NULL,
  go_pitt_down          = if (exists("go_pitt_down"))  go_pitt_down  else NULL,
  go_sheba_up           = if (exists("go_sheba_up"))   go_sheba_up   else NULL,
  go_sheba_down         = if (exists("go_sheba_down")) go_sheba_down else NULL,
  gsea_pitt             = if (exists("gsea_pitt"))     gsea_pitt     else NULL,
  gsea_sheba            = if (exists("gsea_sheba"))    gsea_sheba    else NULL,
  gsea_concord          = if (exists("gsea_concord"))  gsea_concord  else NULL,
  panel_long            = panel_long,
  panel_concord         = panel_concord,
  host_mg_corr          = if (exists("host_mg_corr"))  host_mg_corr  else NULL
)
cat("§18 — host_state bundled with ",
    sum(!sapply(host_state, is.null)), "/",
    length(host_state), " non-null entries\n", sep="")
```
